label: jit b0 (run 1)
pinning: pinned to the 16 fastest of 28 logical processors (hybrid CPU; --no-pin to disable)

results.name: a11y/type in rich text, bridge on
results.description: Type in a 5,000-block document while an accessibility client listens: the value changes with every key

results.name: a11y/create 1,000 rows, bridge on
results.description: Replace a list with 1,000 fresh rows while an accessibility client listens: tree rebuilt and diffed

results.name: a11y/edit every 10th of 1,000, bridge on
results.description: Change the label of every 10th of 1,000 rows while an accessibility client listens: 100 name changes

results.name: a11y/tab through 300 fields, bridge on
results.description: Press Tab in a 300-field form while an accessibility client listens: focus events, the view scrolls to follow

results.name: a11y/selection walk 1,000 rows, bridge on
results.description: virtual/selection walk with an accessibility client listening: every Down rebuilds and diffs the tree, an item node for each of the list's 1,000 rows

results.name: a11y/selection walk 1,000 item rows, bridge on
results.description: The same walk with .RenderWith((item, selected) => …): every Down still rebuilds and diffs the tree (the row scrolled in), with an item node for each of the 1,000 rows and each one's label

results.name: a11y/selection walk 3,000 item rows, bridge on
results.description: The item-rows walk over 3,000 commits, past the 2,000 a list publishes a node for each of: its items are served on demand when a reader asks, so the tree holds the list's node and none for its items, whatever the list's length (plan 17, round 5, step 14)

results.name: a11y/selection walk beside details, keys 60 ms apart, real loop, bridge on
results.description: Down every 60 ms through a 1,000-commit list on item rows beside a details pane the same Build makes again, in Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock, an accessibility client listening: the trees a key builds (all under build)

results.name: a11y/selection walk beside details, keys 500 ms apart, real loop, bridge on
results.description: The walk beside details above at a reader's pace, Down every 500 ms: past the 100 ms a scroll's refresh waits, so its leading edge rebuilds the tree on every key and the selection move's patch never runs; the trees a key builds (all under build)

results.name: a11y/selection walk beside details and kept chrome parts, keys 60 ms apart, real loop, bridge on
results.description: The walk beside details above inside a window's chrome kept in three child components the Build hands on: a host put back where it was marks no structure, so a key builds no more trees than the walk without the chrome

results.name: a11y/filter a list below 1,000 rows, keys 500 ms apart, bridge on
results.description: A 200-item list below 1,000 rows loses or gains items on each key, as a list filtered while one types does, past the 100 ms a layout refresh waits: the refresh finds the list's items in another number and builds the tree, the case a refresh made in place cannot be (plan 17, round 5, step 13); the trees a key builds

results.name: a11y/type beside a 150-line diff, rows made in Build, bridge on
results.description: Type beside a 150-line diff whose rows Build flattens anew, an accessibility client listening: the list has no item label, so every item is named by its record's ToString()

results.name: a11y/type beside a 150-line diff, rows kept and labelled, bridge on
results.description: The same with the rows flattened once, on item rows, and named by a label made once per row

results.name: a11y/progress bar ticks over 1,000 rows, bridge on

results.name: a11y/label ticking in a dialog over 1,000 rows, bridge on
